set.body:
Problem

tools/scenarios/export_fit_public_f_contrast_fixture.py currently fails --check because its Scala template still emits retired scalafim.linalg DoubleMatrix/DoubleVector values. The checked-in fixture has already moved to Gale, while the generated JSON remains numerically identical.

Scope

Repair the generator and strengthen its reproducibility receipt. Do not regenerate numerical truth merely to silence the check.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Generated Scala uses the current Gale-backed shared test surface and contains no retired scalafim.linalg imports.
- [ ] Regeneration leaves the numerical JSON byte-identical unless an independently justified oracle change is documented.
- [ ] Running the exporter twice in the same pinned environment is byte-deterministic.
- [ ] --check succeeds from a clean checkout and fails after a deliberate generated-file perturbation.
- [ ] The receipt records schema version, producer command, source/reference revisions, Python package versions, convention identifiers, and SHA-256 payload hashes.
- [ ] PublicFContrastScenarioSuite passes on JVM and Scala.js using the generated shared fixture.
- [ ] Ordinary Scala tests require no runtime Python, R, Nilearn, or fmrimod installation.
- [ ] Any accepted cross-engine difference is explicit in the receipt rather than hidden by looser tolerances.
set.title: P0.1: repair the public F-contrast fixture exporter and receipt
